structure.note: Base ramps (neutral 0–13, hue ramps 0–9) feed functional roles named <property>-<role>-<emphasis> (bgColor-accent-emphasis, fgColor-muted, borderColor-default). 14 themes including colour-blind and high-contrast variants.

color.note: The accent is blue; the primary button is green (button-primary-bgColor-rest aliases bgColor-success-emphasis).

findings: No token for direction, language or script. Font stacks are Latin (Mona Sans VF, system fonts, Noto Sans) and line heights are five unitless ratios (tight 1.25 … loose 1.75) unrelated to script.

Density is tokenised as a spacing variant, not as height: every control size has paddingInline condensed / normal / spacious and stacks have gap condensed / normal / spacious; control heights do not change with density.

Touch is tokenised through the pointer media query: --control-minTarget-auto is 2.75rem under (pointer: coarse) and 1rem under (pointer: fine), and stack gaps grow on coarse pointers. This is the only system in the set that publishes a touch-target minimum as a token.
Focus ring is tokenised (width 2px, offset −2px, inset).

gaps: Primitives do not bind a font size or line height to a control size; the control line box here is derived.
